title: BitGo Korea: Building the Infrastructure for Korea’s Next Phase of Digital Assets
summary: BitGo Korea is the first new Korean entity established by a global digital asset company to secure VASP registration in South Korea.
body_markdown:
## Key takeaways


-


BitGo Korea has received acceptance of its Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) registration by the Korea Financial Intelligence Unit (KoFIU), and is now approved to provide virtual asset custody and transfer services to institutional and enterprise clients in South Korea.


-


BitGo Korea is the first new Korean entity established by a global digital asset company to secure VASP registration in South Korea.


-


Hana Financial Group and SK Telecom are strategic shareholders in BitGo Korea, combining BitGo’s global digital asset infrastructure with the financial and technology expertise of two leading Korean institutions.


On August 18, 2026 BitGo Korea reached an important milestone, receiving acceptance of its VASP registration by the Korea Financial Intelligence Unit (KoFIU) and becoming the first new Korean entity established by a global digital asset company to secure VASP registration in South Korea.


The registration establishes a regulated local foundation for BitGo to serve institutional and enterprise clients in South Korea, beginning with registered virtual asset custody and transfer services.


## Built in Korea. Backed by BitGo’s global infrastructure.


This milestone reflects how BitGo approached entering the Korean market: by building locally from the ground up.


Rather than entering Korea through the acquisition of an existing VASP, BitGo established BitGo Korea as a new local entity and completed the VASP registration process directly. That meant bringing technology and infrastructure BitGo has spent more than a decade building for institutions around the world into Korea, while establishing local security, anti-money laundering, internal controls, and operational frameworks designed to meet applicable Korean regulatory requirements.


The result combines a locally established foundation with BitGo’s globally proven technology, security, and institutional infrastructure.


Hana Financial Group and SK Telecom are also strategic shareholders in BitGo Korea, bringing together BitGo’s global digital asset infrastructure with the financial and technology expertise of two leading Korean institutions. That combination reflects how BitGo believes digital asset markets should develop: globally connected, locally grounded, and built around security standards institutions expect.


## Infrastructure built for institutions


BitGo Korea is focused on institutional and enterprise clients, including financial institutions, asset managers, corporates, public-sector organizations, and other qualified market participants. From launch, BitGo Korea is registered to provide virtual asset custody and transfer services to institutional and enterprise clients in South Korea. These capabilities establish the foundation for institutions to manage digital assets.


## From securing digital assets to powering digital finance


BitGo was founded in 2013 to solve one of digital assets’ earliest infrastructure challenges: security. Since then, we’ve expanded beyond wallets and custody to build infrastructure that helps institutions securely hold, move, trade, stake, finance, and manage digital assets.


The idea remains the same: new financial markets need infrastructure institutions can trust.


BitGo Korea brings that philosophy to South Korea, combining local regulatory alignment and support with globally proven digital asset infrastructure. Because the next phase of digital assets won’t be built on access alone, it will require the infrastructure to operate securely, transparently, and at scale.

**About BitGo**


BitGo is the digital asset infrastructure company, delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since our founding in 2013, we have been focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. With a global presence and multiple regulated entities, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of retail investors worldwide.
